mission.hypothesis: Parallelizing the independent per-option loop should improve throughput on large inputs while preserving each option's baseline arithmetic and operation order. Limiting the team to the positive run thread budget and input count avoids excess workers; keeping small counts out of a multi-thread team should reduce launch overhead. These effects remain to be measured.

retained: Parallelize the per-option loop with an OpenMP static worksharing loop when count is at least 128 and more than one thread is available.
Bound the OpenMP team size by the positive run threads argument and count; use one thread for nonpositive counts.
Move the binomial scratch array into the loop body so each iteration has private scratch state, retaining the baseline arithmetic and operation order.

model_interpretation.hypothesis: Parallelizing the independent per-option loop should improve throughput on large inputs while preserving each option's baseline arithmetic and operation order. Limiting the team to the positive run thread budget and input count avoids excess workers; keeping small counts out of a multi-thread team should reduce launch overhead. These effects remain to be measured.

retained: Parallelize the per-option loop with an OpenMP static worksharing loop when count is at least 128 and more than one thread is available.
Bound the OpenMP team size by the positive run threads argument and count; use one thread for nonpositive counts.
Move the binomial scratch array into the loop body so each iteration has private scratch state, retaining the baseline arithmetic and operation order.

Inputs are read-only and 64-byte aligned. Overwrite the full specified output on every call; no cached answers, external tools or libraries, filesystem, environment inspection, timing inspection or phase detection. Ordinary C++17, OpenMP and x86 intrinsics are available. Do not modify the protected correctness or timing protocol. Scratch allocation inside run is allowed and included in timing. The harness measures native wall-clock time, excluding input generation, oracle and compilation. Search and confirmation use different seeds. Numerical tolerances are fixed. The optimized reference source is withheld. Choose topics independently, record failed attempts, complete memory integration and independently confirm final G.
